description: This file defines the EraseChip class, which provides a GUI component for erasing the firmware chip on a device using OpenOCD commands. It extends ProcessStatusWindow and includes a button that, when clicked, prompts the user for confirmation and then executes the erase command.

classes.name: EraseChip
classes.description: A GUI component for erasing the firmware memory of a device, with a button triggering the erase operation after user confirmation.

methods.name: EraseChip
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the erase button and sets its action listener for initiating the chip erase process.

methods.name: getEraseCommand
methods.description: Builds and returns the command string used to erase the device's flash memory.

methods.name: getButton
methods.description: Returns the JButton component associated with this erase chip window.
